supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: extension visible beyond the lateral canthi of the eyes

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: high contrast between the light-grey/white muzzle area and the dark-pigmented cheek and periocular regions

maxillary_and_labial_geometry.resting_lip_thickness: thin 2D vertical thickness with a tightly closed, non-drooping lower lip

pinna_silhouette.severe_cartilage_deformities: visible V-shaped notch or structural loss on the superior helix of the left ear

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: prominent notch/defect on the upper quadrant of the left ear helix
other_distinctive_markers: dense white/grey hair distribution across the chin and lower muzzle creating a beard-like appearance
